# v0.9.0b1 — Wallbox events for automations

Integration beta. The app stays at **0.8.2**; no app update is needed.

- **New event entity Wallbox event:** what the wallbox changed on its own,
  as the counterpart to **Control result**, which reports your commands. It
  reports a car plugged in or unplugged (with the energy and duration of the
  session), a charge started or stopped, a fault that appeared or cleared
  (with code and category), an RFID authorization or rejection, a downgrade,
  a cable lock and a phase switch. Only a change between two known readings
  creates an event; a start, a reload or a lost connection sets a baseline
  and reports nothing. Enabled by default; it records only those changes.

[React to wallbox events](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b1/docs/automations.md#react-to-wallbox-events) ·
